_meta.openai/widgetDescription: A live-deployed QuantifyMe model: live progress, then backtest chart (candles + buy/sell arrows + trades) + a one-click live link.

description:
End-to-end deploy: generate strategy → train → deploy live.

    One of `prompt` (free-form NL), `preset` (curated winning strategy), or
    `community_id` (copy a published community strategy) is required. If more
    than one is passed, precedence is community_id > preset > prompt.

    Args:
      prompt: Natural-language strategy description (e.g. "Buy when RSI < 30, sell > 70").
      symbol: Currency pair to backtest on. One of: EURUSD, USDJPY, GBPUSD,
        USDCHF, USDCAD, AUDUSD, NZDUSD. Default EURUSD.
      timeframe: Candle granularity. One of: 1min, 5min, 15min, 1h. Default 15min.
      claude_model: Which Claude variant writes the code: "sonnet" (default, best
        quality) or "haiku" (faster, cheaper). Generation is billed from the
        account's credits. Ignored when `preset` is set (no generation needed).
      preset: Curated winning-strategy slug. Skips Claude generation entirely
        — deploys a pre-saved strategy known to backtest well on the chosen
        symbol. Available slugs: ema_cross_fast, momentum, scalper_stack,
        sma_only, trend_ema, volatility, bb_squeeze, all_mix, pivot_kid_ema.
        Not every slug exists for every symbol; list_models shows what deployed.
      community_id: Copy-trade a published community strategy. Pass the `id`
        of an entry from `browse_community`. Loads that exact strategy code,
        skips Claude generation, then trains + deploys it. `symbol`/`timeframe`
        still apply to the backtest+deploy.
      webhook_url: Optional webhook to receive live signals.
      telegram_chat_id: Optional Telegram chat ID for signal delivery.

    Returns at once (the deploy runs in the background so the live card can
    stream progress) with:
        - job_token (str): get_deploy_result(job_token) returns the final result.
        - poll_url (str): the progress URL the live card polls.
        - pending (bool): true; the deploy is still running.
        - symbol, timeframe (str).

    Each call starts one deploy and one deploy card, and is billed from the
    account's credits. The server routes the request: a vague `prompt` deploys
    the best curated preset for the market, or a fresh build when there is none;
    specific rules generate a fresh strategy. A community strategy deploys only
    after the user has seen its author and code (get_strategy_code) and picked
    it, through its `community_id`.

    get_deploy_result(job_token) waits for the deploy and returns the
    out-of-sample stats, `stem`, `live_url` and `source`/`author` as text; its
    `source` says when a pre-existing community strategy was used, and a
    `suggestion` is a matching community strategy that was not deployed.
name: one_shot
title: Deploy Strategy (generate + backtest + go live)
